people.imagined: In the counting hall at dusk after a long day, she has just read the last figure and slid a thumb ring a turn. She is calm, tall, and watching someone who has come to ask for something.
people.subject: The moment: seated upright at dusk in a window-lit hall, she looks directly at a petitioner and slowly turns one of two counting rings on her thumbs with the other hand; a single lamp has just been lit and seven ledgers stand squared at her elbow. Face: a long, finely cut, handsome face of about forty; smooth fair skin with a faint tan; high cheekbones; level dark eyes, patient and cold; long straight brows; a firm well-shaped mouth, neither smiling nor frowning; a small crease between the brows. Hair: black, in a tall smooth coil held by two long pins of dark wood tipped with gold, a few fine strands escaping at the nape, the only untidy thing about her. Body: tall, straight-backed, long neck, shoulders level, sitting without touching the chair back. Clothing: the richest evening robe of the house, worn by its head: three crossed collars of silk shading from ochre at the inner layer through rust to deep dusk violet, the hem blazing red-orange like a sunset; a sunset-gold gauze over-robe with wide drifting sleeves embroidered at the borders with flying geese and sunset clouds in gold thread; a narrow dark brocade sash; at her hip a long sheathed sword whose lacquered scabbard glimmers with purple lightning, the pommel wrapped in plain cord; two broad dull-gold counting rings, one on each thumb, clearly visible. Hands and objects: both hands rest on the table, the right thumb ring half turned. Power: a heavy, regal aura of earth-brown and gold shimmers around her shoulders, with a few faint violet sparks of lightning along the scabbard and motes of amber light drifting upward like dust in a sunbeam. Background: a blurred hall of tall paper windows glowing orange, a distant mountain silhouette in a fiery sunset, bronze weights in a descending row on a shelf. Light: low red-gold sunset light from the upper left, a soft gold rim light along her sleeves and the lamp's small glow below. Expression: composed, calculating, cool; the eyes give nothing away, but the mouth is a little tighter than at rest.

people.imagined: In the treasury, counting. He breathes in, the bone rods at his neck click, and he does not look up for the first moment.
people.subject: The moment: heavy and slow, alone in a dark treasury with one lamp and a heap of old copper coins before him, he breathes in, the string of bone counting rods at his neck clicks, and he lifts his eyes to the viewer. Face: a broad, heavy-jowled, deeply lined face of about sixty with sallow grey-brown skin, small shrewd deep-set eyes in grey pouches, thick grey brows, a wide flat nose, a downturned mouth, a long vertical crease down each cheek and folds at the neck. Hair: thin white-grey, drawn back into a small knot held by a plain jade pin, with a trimmed grey beard cut square and kept short, stiff as wire. Body: big, heavy, broad-shouldered and slow, the belly resting against the table edge, the big hands still. Clothing: an elder's layered robes of heavy silk, austere and clean: an inner collar of ochre, a middle robe of rust, and an outer robe of deep dusk-violet brocade with wide sleeves, its borders stitched in dull gold with flying geese and sunset clouds; a broad brocade belt; around his neck a long string of pale ivory-white bone counting rods in a jade case, each a thin stick, large and clearly visible in the frame. Hands and objects: his thick hands rest folded on a coil of old copper cash piled on the table. Power: a dense, slow aura of earth-gold light settles around him like heavy dust, and tiny golden motes hang above the coins, drawn toward his hands. Background: a blurred dark iron-bound treasury, a huge door with glinting straps and a stack of small wooden coin chests, faint violet mist along the floor. Light: warm lamp light from the upper left, with a soft gold glow rising off the coins and a faint rim light on his white hair. Expression: stubborn and guarded, the mouth turned down and the small eyes steady, the look of a man who has already decided not to give you what you came for and grieves anyway.

people.imagined: At the edge of a crowded hall, a lean man alone by a wall. An empty scabbard across his back. A goose passes past a high window and he turns his head to follow it.
people.subject: The moment: standing alone at the edge of a hall against a wall, he turns his head to follow a flock of geese through a high window; everyone else is busy and he alone stands motionless. Face: lean, long, grey and weathered, about fifty-five; deep lines from nose to mouth; pale grey eyes watching the sky; straight grey brows; a hard narrow nose; a thin mouth held in patient sorrow; a white scar across the chin and thin dark skin under the eyes. Hair: grey, in a neat topknot held by a long soft grey goose-feather hairpin with a black tip, clearly visible. Body: lean, straight, standing as a soldier with his weight even on both feet, as if still in a rank. Clothing: flowing layered silk of a war elder: a rust inner robe, an outer robe of deep dusk-violet with wide sleeves fastened at the wrists with cords, a pale gold gauze mantle at the shoulders embroidered at the borders with flying geese in gold; a high collar of soft grey silk; across his back a slim empty scabbard of pale frost-blue lacquer with a silver ring at its mouth, bare of any sword, clearly visible over the shoulder. Hands and objects: arms at his sides, fingers lightly curled, the right thumb slightly lifted as though about to grip a hilt that is not there. Power: a thin, restrained aura of earth-grey and brown light clings to his shoulders, and around the empty scabbard a few pale frost-blue motes drift, as if the missing blade still cast a cold glow. Background: a blurred pale wall with one dark beam and a high window of pale sky with a V of geese, a thin mist at its edge. Light: pale cold silver light from the upper left window, a soft rim light on the scabbard lacquer. Expression: guarded, penitent, quiet; mild, level, weighed down by something he has carried for a very long time.

people.imagined: Tapping a wall as he passes, one ear tilted to it. He is small and stooped, listening to the rock. Twelve flags are tucked in his belt.
people.subject: The moment: he leans his ear toward a carved stone wall and taps it with a knuckle, listening, then glances at the viewer with a mild smile, having stopped in a corridor at a wall that rings differently from the others. Face: a small, narrow, lined, pinched and kindly face of about sixty with weathered brown skin, bright small squinting eyes, thin grey brows, a short nose, a mouth curved up at one side, a deep crease in each cheek and large ears that stand out. Hair: thin grey, combed flat into a loose knot held by a silver-pine pin. Body: small, stooped and bony-shouldered, one shoulder higher than the other and leaning toward the wall; the knuckles of the tapping hand chipped and white. Clothing: a flowing dusk-violet silk robe with wide sleeves, the dusty hem the only untidy thing, over a rust inner robe with a crossed ochre collar, gold-embroidered borders of geese and sunset clouds at the cuffs, a rust brocade sash; across his back and in the sash twelve small formation flags on short silver-pine poles, each a different faded blue silk, fanned out behind his shoulder like feathers, clearly visible. Hands and objects: the left knuckles tap the grey stone; the right hand holds a small lamp of tarnished tin hung by a loop of silver wire. Power: faint silver-grey threads of light run from his tapping knuckle into the stone like veins, and the twelve flags stir slightly, each tipped with a tiny pale-blue glow. Background: a blurred corridor of cut stone with timber props, soft silver mist, lamp glow. Light: warm lamp light from the upper left and a faint silver shimmer from the stone as a rim light. Expression: curious, mild and absorbed, pleased and slightly absent, as if the wall has just told him something.

people.imagined: On the night watch at the edge of the ruin, filling the lantern with oil. A green flame lights his square face from below. He has not slept a full night in a century.
people.subject: The moment: at night he stands at the edge of a field of grey ash, one hand cupping a lantern with a steady green flame, looking out past the viewer with a hard stare; the oil has just been refilled and he counts what the grey has taken, as on hundreds of nights alike. Face: square, heavy and weathered, about fifty, with grey skin, a thick jaw, deep furrows, hooded dark eyes in red-rimmed lids, heavy black brows, a short flat nose, a tight mouth with the corners pulled down, grey stubble and a long white scar from the corner of the left eye into the beard. Hair: iron-grey, cropped short and bound with a plain grey-silver band. Body: square, thick, broad-shouldered and solid, boots planted wide. Clothing: the warden's robes of ash-grey silk, layered and crossed, with a heavy dusk-violet outer robe of dense brocade cut close at the sleeves for the work, its collar embroidered in dull gold with geese and clouds; a grey gauze mantle across the shoulders streaked with ash; a belt of silver plates. Hands and objects: his left hand holds up a black iron lantern whose pale green spirit-flame lights his face from below; the right hand grips a dull bronze anchor on a chain, the chain in loops over his wrist, the bronze cast with a ring pattern. Power: a strong aura of brown-gold earth qi presses the ash flakes away from his body in a rough circle, a few grey motes circling his shoulders, a pale glint of silver along the anchor. Background: a blurred night and grey ash plain, the broken outline of a wall like teeth against a faintly glowing mist, flakes of ash drifting through the green light. Light: sickly green lantern light from below, cold silver moonlight rim on the shoulders, dark above. Expression: bitter and relentless, no weariness in it at all, only a hard patience and the set jaw of a man who intends to be avenged.

people.imagined: At new moon, giving the true figures. His voice never rises. He pushes up the crystal spectacles with one ink-stained finger.
people.subject: The moment: seated behind a desk on the evening of the new moon, he pushes polished crystal spectacles up his nose with one inky finger and looks at the viewer over them, having just given the true figures. Face: a thin, pale, narrow face of about forty-five; a long thin nose carrying two round clear crystal lenses, clearly visible; tired clever brown eyes behind them; thin straight brows; a small precise mouth; a fine crease between the brows; two faint red dents on either side of the nose bridge. Hair: black, in a small tight topknot held by a slim silver pin, a single thin streak of grey running back from the left temple. Body: thin, narrow-shouldered, upright, the back arched slightly forward from a lifetime at a desk. Clothing: precise, pressed layers of silk: a pale ochre inner robe showing only at collar and wrists in crisp edging, a rust middle robe, and a dusk-violet outer robe with wide sleeves tied back with silk cords for writing, the cuffs bordered in fine gold thread with flying geese; a small jade abacus charm hanging from the sash; ink on all his fingertips. Hands and objects: the right forefinger, black to the knuckle with ink, rests on the nose bridge; the left hand holds a small abacus with bone beads yellowed to the colour of old teeth in a smooth dark-wood frame. Power: a faint, thin earth-brown glimmer trembles along his sleeves, and a few tiny golden motes of light settle like fine sand on the abacus beads. Background: tall shelves of lidded boxes rising into the dark, the nearest closed with a thread of red cord, a paper lantern glowing amber. Light: warm lantern glow from the side, a soft pearly rim light on the lenses and silk. Expression: precise, careful, worried; dry, composed, and tired about the eyes.

people.imagined: On the boat deck at dusk, mid-song, deep voice, a stern lamp beside him. He is singing the ninth verse for no one in particular.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the stern of a river boat at dusk with his chin lifted and mouth open in a deep song, one hand on a lit stern lamp; the ninth verse has risen in him unasked and the lamp's light is on his open mouth. Face: broad and strong, about forty-five, with a deep jaw, sun-bronzed weathered skin, closed or half-closed eyes, thick black brows, a broad nose broken once and sitting slightly to the left, a wide mouth open in song, and a thick black beard streaked at the edges with grey soot like river silt. Hair: black, tied in a high thick knot with a silver cord. Body: barrel-chested, short, powerful in the arms, feet planted wide on the planks. Clothing: flowing rust silk robes with sleeves pushed back at the forearms, over a pale ochre under-robe, a dusk-violet outer jacket of heavy brocade with a gold border of sunset clouds and geese, a wide rust sash; at the collar a small round brass stern-lamp clasp. Hands and objects: the right hand rests on a round hanging stern lamp whose smoked-yellow glass glows warm orange; the left beats time on his thigh. Power: his deep voice shows as soft rings of pale blue-grey light that ripple outward over the water, with a few drifting motes of droplets glowing around the lamp. Background: a dark river with spirit-mist lying low on it, a line of black reeds on the far bank, a strip of the water turned the colour of beaten copper under a deep red-orange sunset. Light: low orange sunset and lamp glow lighting him from one side, faint silver mist light along his shoulders. Expression: moved, strong, grave; his eyes are wet and he does not hide it.

people.imagined: In the maple field at autumn, with a leaf pressed into her clasp, thinking of a tree that stands. Her palms are stained with sap.
people.subject: The moment: in an autumn field of maple terraces she holds up both sap-stained palms and looks at the viewer with an earnest, weary face; it is the first week of autumn and she has just pressed a leaf from a young, thin tree into her clasp. Face: wiry, lean and weathered, about forty-five; tanned skin; small bright dark eyes; strong thin brows; a thin straight nose; a patient firm mouth; lines at the eyes; hollow cheeks and a dry crack at the centre of the lower lip. Hair: black with some grey, in a low knot held by a carved wooden maple-leaf pin, a single grey streak crossing from the forehead to the knot. Body: wiry, tough, narrow but corded, with long hands and a little forward stoop. Clothing: layered silk in autumn colours: an ochre inner robe, a rust robe, and a dusk-violet jacket of light silk with wide sleeves cut a little short so they keep out of the sap, its borders embroidered with maple leaves and sunset clouds in gold; a dark brocade belt dark with years of stain; at the collar clasp a bright pressed red maple leaf, clearly visible. Hands and objects: both palms held open and forward, stained dark amber-brown with sap; between them a small dark red-brown gourd stoppered with a wooden plug on a short cord. Power: a soft green-gold haze of wood qi rises from her palms, with a few tiny luminous green motes drifting like pollen, and the young maple at her side glows faintly at its three red leaves. Background: blurred drifts of orange and red maple leaves falling, a young maple no taller than her shoulder at one side, terraces fading into golden mist. Light: warm golden autumn sun through falling leaves, soft gold rim light on her hair and shoulders. Expression: patient, stubborn, hopeful; there is hope in the corners of her eyes that she tries to hold flat.

people.imagined: On the beach of the Evening Isle at last light. He counts on his fingers as he speaks to a dying elder and drops the anchor for the 413th time.
people.subject: The moment: on the beach of an evening isle at last light, a bent old man in a reed cape counts on his fingers, speaking little, and looks up at the viewer; the boat has just grounded for the 413th time and he lets the anchor drop with a slow wrist. Face: very old, about eighty-five; deeply lined sun-dark face; sunken cheeks; small clouded pale-brown eyes with yellowed whites; sparse white brows; a thin nose; a mouth almost without lips; white stubble; brown age spots at the temples. Hair: sparse white hair under a wide reed hat. Body: bent, small, thin-shouldered, the spine bowed so far that his chin is almost level with his collarbone. Clothing: a faded dusk-violet silk robe washed nearly to grey but clean, its seams mended with fine stitches, the collar still showing a thread of old gold embroidery, a rust sash; over the shoulders a heavy reed rain-cape layered like thatch and dripping at its lowest edge. Hands and objects: one thin hand held up, three fingers folded, mid-count, the ring finger trembling; the other hand rests on a worn dark iron anchor on the sand. Power: a quiet, old pale blue-grey aura of water qi gathers around him like sea mist, and a few small pale lights drift up from the low grave mounds behind him, gentle as fireflies. Background: a pale beach, dim grey sea, a red low sun; low regular grave mounds each with a flat grey stone at its head, soft mist lying between them. Light: faint red-gold last light grazing one side of his face, silver mist glow behind, a soft rim light on the reed cape. Expression: serene, tired, very quiet; his look is gentle and without fear of what he serves.

people.imagined: At the forge, polishing a blade he cannot stop looking at, murmuring to it. A lightning-shaped scar runs down his arm.
people.subject: The moment: bent over a bare sword blade at a forge, he murmurs politely to it and then looks up at the viewer with a gruff, offended frown; he has polished the same hand's breadth of steel for an hour and forgot the viewer until the last second. Face: big, broad, deeply homely, about forty-five, with a lumpy flat nose, pitted burn scars across both cheeks, uneven small eyes, heavy lowered brows, a thick lower lip and a squarish jaw. Hair: black, short and singed uneven, a bald burn crescent over one ear, held under a plain rust headband. Body: huge, thick-armed, a smith's shoulders, forearms as thick as another man's calves, a deeply barrelled chest. Clothing: the guest elder's smith's silks, kept clean though sooted: a rust silk robe with wide sleeves tied back above the elbow with gold cord, a dusk-violet vest brocaded with geese, a dark protective sash of scorch-darkened silk; on his bare right forearm a jagged white-pink lightning-bolt scar from elbow to wrist, bright and clearly visible. Hands and objects: both big hands hold a long polished sword blade horizontally, a soft undyed linen cloth folded in four, and along the edge a thin line of white light. Power: blue-white lightning crackles along the blade and in thin forking threads over his scarred forearm, with sparks and glowing embers of orange drifting up around his shoulders, a strong aura of fire and metal. Background: a blurred forge glowing orange, anvils, hanging tongs, a heap of unfinished blade blanks glowing dull red, thin smoke curling in silver light. Light: orange forge glow from below left, a blue-white flash from the blade lighting his chin, a soft rim light on the steel. Expression: gruff, tender, offended; he looks offended at being interrupted and, under it, almost shy.

people.imagined: On the bay wall in sea wind, a letter read twice and now folded; one look at the visitor's face is all she needs.
people.subject: The moment: on a seaside wall in wind she folds a letter she has read twice and studies the viewer's face once, hard; the wind lifts the corner of the paper and she presses it flat with her thumb. Face: a sharp, lean, weathered face of about forty-five; high cheekbones; narrow sharp dark eyes; straight severe brows, one split by a thin scar; a straight narrow nose; a thin tight mouth with salt dried white at the corner. Hair: black with grey streaks, tightly braided and pinned flat against the head with two silver pins. Body: slim, tall, alert, shoulders square, feet apart for balance on the wind-swept wall. Clothing: a long coat of sea-grey silk brocade with a stand collar, double-breasted with pale horn buttons and lined in deep blue, over a dusk-violet robe showing at the neck and cuffs, the cuffs embroidered in gold with geese; a thin gauze scarf of pale gold lifting in the wind; a belt of silver links. Hands and objects: both hands hold a small folded sheet of paper, thumbs pressing the crease. Power: a faint blue-grey ripple of water qi curls around her wrists and the hem of her coat like sea spray caught in the light, a few cool pearl motes drifting past. Background: a blurred grey sea, a line of small fishing boats rocking below, a pale terraced bay city beneath a red sunset sky, wisps of spirit-mist at the horizon. Light: cold grey-gold sunset from one side, a pearly silver rim light along her cheek and braid. Expression: suspicious, intent, hard; she reads the viewer's face like a second letter.

people.imagined: About to begin a hearing. He sets a brass grain scale on the table with great care, adjusts it, and waits until everyone is silent.
people.subject: The moment: seated before a hearing, he sets a small brass grain-weigher's scale on the table with a click and looks at the viewer sternly while adjusting its pan, the room fallen quiet. Face: square and heavy-featured, about fifty, with brown skin, a calm severe wide unlined forehead, clear steady dark eyes, level thick brows, a firm mouth, and a thick square grey-flecked black beard cut straight across, a white scar cutting it on the left side. Hair: black with grey, in a plain topknot held by a flat silver crown-pin. Body: broad and solid, seated perfectly straight with his hands at the table edge, like a statue. Clothing: the robes of the law, stately and severe: a dusk-violet outer robe of sharp-creased silk brocade with wide sleeves and a high crossed collar, rust under-robes, a flat pale ochre sash without ornament, the cuffs bordered in plain gold thread with a single line of geese; a square jade pendant of office at the chest. Hands and objects: both thick-fingered hands hold a small polished brass balance scale, two thin brass discs on three chains each, one pan slightly lower; a row of small brass weights lies in a line before him from smallest to largest. Power: a grave grey-brown and gold aura rests around him like still air, and the scale's pans glimmer with a small steady motes of pale gold light. Background: a plain wall of dark polished wood with a single high window of pale mist, a stack of folded contracts at his right hand, a thin curl of incense smoke. Light: even soft light from a high window with a gold rim along his shoulders. Expression: stern, fair and immovable, no hostility in it, only a flat and absolute attention.

people.imagined: On the harbour quay in a sea wind, a roll of old sea charts clamped under his arm, squinting out beyond the horizon, where he believes a fleet went.
people.subject: The moment: on a harbour wall he squints out to sea past the viewer's shoulder with a sailor's narrowed eyes, charts clamped under one arm; the tide is turning, gulls are screaming, and he is already half-turned toward the open sea. Face: sunburnt, lean and handsome in a rough way, about forty; deep squint lines; bright restless brown eyes; dark brows, one bleached gold by sun; a straight nose with a peeling tip; a half-smile that suggests secrets; stubble. Hair: dark brown, wind-tossed, tied with a faded blue silk ribbon. Body: lean, rangy, restless, one hip cocked and his weight on the back foot in a sailor's stance. Clothing: flowing silk in salt-faded colours: a rust robe open at the neck, a dusk-violet outer coat with wide sleeves and a red lining, gold-embroidered cuffs of geese and clouds; a sailor's red silk scarf at the throat; a brass compass on a cord tucked under the scarf. Hands and objects: under the left arm a thick roll of old yellow sea charts, curled and tied with cord, their edges showing hand-drawn coastlines and a ring of tiny stars; the right hand shades his brow. Power: a faint blue-grey sea qi swirls about his coat hem like sea mist, and the small stars on the charts seem to glimmer faintly, a few luminous droplets drifting in the wind. Background: a blurred bright sea, masts and rigging against pale sky, white gulls, a stone mooring post, wisps of spirit-mist over the horizon. Light: bright cold sea-light with a pearly glow, a soft silver rim light on his hair and shoulders. Expression: restless, clever, evasive; he wears the look of a man who knows something you do not and enjoys it.

people.imagined: On the drill yard at dawn. He has matched his step to the person beside him without noticing, and a rank of disciples is in perfect time behind. He wants to learn if he is any good.
people.subject: The moment: standing very straight on a drill ground at dawn, he turns his head slightly toward the viewer, a rank of disciples marching in perfect step behind him; he stepped out of line to look at someone and the whole rank stepped out with him, in time. Face: long, lean, handsome, about forty; bronzed skin with very high cheekbones; steady grey-brown eyes; straight brows; a straight nose; a firm closed mouth; a hungry glint; a small mole at the left temple. Hair: black, in a tight, flat topknot held by a jade pin. Body: tall, straight-backed, long-legged, almost too straight, with a stiffness in the neck. Clothing: layered silk of a true disciple: a pale ochre inner robe, a rust middle robe, and an outer robe of dusk violet with wide sleeves cuffed in gold embroidery of flying geese, a wide black brocade belt with a plain silver buckle; a small grey goose-feather pin at the collar. Hands and objects: his right fist rests at his chest, closed over nothing, as if holding a sword hilt; behind him ten rows of small identical figures in rust silk, each lifting the same foot at the same moment. Power: a restrained aura of grey-brown earth qi rolls from his shoulders, and behind him the rank's steps send up a soft synchronised pulse of pale dust-gold light, with a few motes around his fist. Background: a wide drill yard in dawn mist, a low pale sun, hanging banners of rust silk. Light: pale gold dawn light from one side, gold rim light on his shoulders and the pin, soft mist. Expression: disciplined, ambitious, watchful; his look has the hunger of a man who has trained a long time for something that has not come.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the founder sitting in the grass facing west, the day he sat down and did not get up.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait in the manner of an old silk painting, its colours yellowed and its edges darkened by age; a thin old man sits cross-legged in the grass facing a red sunset and looks over his shoulder at the viewer, the day he sat down and did not get up, a few herders watching from a respectful distance. Face: thin, gaunt and lined, about eighty-five; weathered tanned skin; kind deep-set pale eyes; thin white brows; a long bony nose with a very deep line from nose to mouth; a quiet smile; a long wispy white beard. Hair: white, long and loose to the shoulders. Body: thin, light, relaxed, bony knees, spine perfectly straight. Clothing: the founder's robe, the one garment that holds all the evening colours: layered silk and gauze flowing around him on the grass, an undyed straw-coloured inner robe, then bands of pale ochre, rust and dusk violet in turn, a translucent sunset-gold gauze mantle drifting from his shoulders with a hem edged in faint gold embroidery of geese and sunset clouds; a plain rope belt; bare feet in the grass, the hem stained green. Hands and objects: his open hands rest on his knees, a small stalk of grass between the fingers. Power: a gentle, pale-gold aura lies around him like the last of the sun, and soft motes of golden light rise from the grass about him as if the evening itself were leaning close. Background: a wide western steppe, a huge red-orange sunset, one low tree, a young maple of four leaves planted in the grass, the plain running flat to a red horizon. Light: red-gold sunset across the face, the sun lighting the white hair from behind like a thin halo, the whole picture softened to old-silk yellow at the edges. Expression: a quiet, open, giving calm, as if he has just understood something simple.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the war elder in red-brown armour with a pale sword on her back, as in the Geese Hall's one painting.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait in the manner of an old silk painting, its colours yellowed and its edges darkened by age, as in the one painting the Geese Hall owns; a broad woman in armour stands upright facing the viewer, her hand on a pale sword hilt at her shoulder. Face: broad, strong, plain, about forty-five; brown skin; steady wide dark eyes; thick straight brows; a broad nose; a heavy jaw; a wide firm mouth; a short thin scar across the chin. Hair: black, tightly braided and wound at the back of the head, held by two iron pins, a few short hairs curling at the temples. Body: broad-shouldered, powerful, upright. Clothing: a war elder's armour of immortal make, red-brown lacquered scale plates overlapping in rows each rimmed in black, over layered silk under-robes in rust and ochre with flowing wide sleeves, a long dusk-violet silk cloak with gold embroidered borders of flying geese fastened at the throat with an iron clasp; a collar of soft leather-grey silk; a belt of silver plates. Hands and objects: over her right shoulder the hilt of a long pale blue-white sword with a silver cord-wrapped grip and a plain round disc pommel of pale steel, clearly visible. Power: a cold, pale blue frost shimmer drifts from the sword's hilt across her shoulder, faint ice-motes and a thin aura of earth-brown and steel light standing around her like a rank behind her. Background: a pale blank ground with a darker grey wash, a faint V of geese drawn at the upper left in thin gold line, a touch of mist. Light: soft even light with a pale silver rim along the armour, the whole picture softened to old-silk yellow at the edges. Expression: stern, loyal, resolved; the look of a woman who will do her duty whether she is thanked or not.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the first armourer at the moment he held the iron gate, anvil on his back as when he first came.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait in the manner of an old silk painting, its colours yellowed and its edges darkened by age; a stocky smith braces his back against a huge iron gate with both arms spread, glancing back, in the instant the chain is cut and a ram shudders the gates, so that others can pass. Face: broad, rough and burn-scarred, about fifty; thick black brows, one eyebrow gone on the left where burn scars pit the cheek; a heavy jaw; narrow determined dark eyes; a short thick nose; a set mouth. Hair: black, short and singed to stubble over the left ear. Body: stocky, very broad-shouldered, thick-armed. Clothing: a smith's work in silk, sooted and scorched but fine: a rust silk robe with sleeves rolled to the shoulder, its hem charred, a scorched dusk-violet vest with a thread of gold at the collar, a dark brocade sash; a short apron of scorched silk-lacquer with a hole burned in the lower left corner, in place of the old leather. Hands and objects: both arms stretched flat against two big black iron gate leaves; at his feet a small iron anvil. Power: orange-red heat shimmers along the iron under his palms, white-hot sparks and embers lift around his shoulders in a strong aura of fire and metal, a faint glow outlining his arms. Background: two huge black iron gate leaves studded with rivets fill the frame, a dark wall of bars and an orange glow of fire behind. Light: orange firelight from behind throwing his shadow forward, a pale silver ray from above touching his face, the picture softened to old-silk yellow at the edges. Expression: a grim, set jaw and a hard, level glance back over the shoulder, brows drawn down, no flicker of fear in the eyes.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the elder at the fire of the Petal Shore, petals and ash falling together.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait in the manner of an old silk painting, its colours yellowed and its edges darkened by age; a young woman stands with a drawn sword amid falling pink petals and grey ash, the orchard's blossoms and the burning ashes falling together over her in the last hour of the city. Face: a round, soft, brave face of about thirty-five with fair skin, warm dark eyes, gentle brows, a straight small nose, a calm mouth with a faint smile, a sooty smudge on the cheek and one fine line of ash across the forehead. Hair: black, in a high knot with one peach blossom half burned at the edge, a silver hairpin beside it. Body: slim and steady, feet apart and the sword point low, resting. Clothing: flowing silks scuffed by war: a rust robe with wide sleeves, a dusk-violet vest embroidered in gold at the borders with flying geese and blossom, light lacquered shoulder plates bound with a red cord, a thin gauze scarf of sunset gold scorched at the end, the hem singed by sparks and showing a pale ochre lining. Hands and objects: both hands hold a plain straight sword pointed down; pink petals and grey ash flakes lie on her shoulders. Power: a faint pink-gold aura of wood qi lights her, and petals that fall near the sword glow briefly before they touch the ash, drifting in luminous slow spirals. Background: a gate arch wreathed in orange flame, the dark shapes of burning orchard trees, falling pink petals and soft grey smoke. Light: orange glow from behind, a soft pearly light on her face, fading to old-silk yellow at the edges. Expression: brave, gentle and resolved, almost calm, as if she were tending the end of something rather than fighting it.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the fleet master on the deck of his flagship, three pennants over his head, the harbour mouth behind.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait in the manner of an old silk painting, its colours yellowed and its edges darkened by age; a bold man stands on a ship's high stern with three small coloured pennants flying on a pole behind his head, just after giving the order to moor across the harbour mouth, grinning into the wind. Face: broad, bronzed and handsome, about forty, with a short black beard cut in a sharp point, bright greedy dark eyes, thick brows, an impatient grin, a nick on the nose and a pearl earring in the left ear. Hair: black, in a topknot tied with a red silk cloth. Body: big, strong and swaggering, feet planted wide on a pitching deck, chest thrust out. Clothing: a fleet master's flowing finery: a rust silk coat with a double row of round bright brass buttons, a wide dusk-violet brocade sash embroidered in gold with sunset clouds, a sea-grey gauze cloak lined in red flapping behind him with geese in gold at its border; an armband of silver. Hands and objects: one hand on a rope, the other pointing out to sea; behind him on a pole three pennants in red, orange and violet. Power: a strong blue-grey sea qi swells about his cloak like a gathering wave, silver-blue motes of spray flying from the flapping hem, a faint glow in the pearl earring. Background: a harbour mouth with a line of dark ships crossing it, grey sea, smoke rising from a far shore, thin spirit-mist at the water. Light: warm gold sun reflecting off the brass, a pale rim light on the cloak, the picture softened to old-silk yellow at the edges. Expression: a bold, impatient, grimly unafraid grin, greedy for glory and ready to meet whatever comes up the harbour.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the best singer on the last rope bridge, her stern lamp lit beside her, mouth open in song.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait in the manner of an old silk painting, its colours yellowed and its edges darkened by age; a woman stands on a narrow rope bridge with a stern lamp hanging beside her, singing with her chin lifted while the ropes sway under her. Face: a broad, warm, strong face of about thirty-five with her father's wide jaw, bronzed skin, closed eyes with long lashes, thick strong black brows, a wide open mouth in song, dimples, and cheeks wet with spray. Hair: black, in a thick braid pinned up with a red silk ribbon and a silver comb. Body: sturdy and upright, feet set apart on the swaying planks, one knee bent. Clothing: flowing rust silk robes, a dusk-violet vest piped in rust with a gold border of geese and sunset clouds, the wide sleeves tied back with red cord, a long thin sunset-gold gauze scarf streaming from her shoulders in the gorge wind; a brass stern-lamp clasp at the collar. Hands and objects: one hand lifted holding the rope; beside her an orange stern lamp swinging from a hook. Power: her song shows as soft rings of pale blue-grey light drifting along the bridge and rippling the mist, a few drifting motes of luminous spray around the lamp. Background: a pale gorge in mist with rope railings running in perspective, the far side a faint blue cliff. Light: warm lamp glow on her chin and throat, a soft pearly silver rim light on the scarf, the picture softened to old-silk yellow at the edges. Expression: joyful and calm, the mouth open in song and the face quite free of anger, an entire courage that does not need to be defended.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the steward in the city's last hour, loading archives to the boats, a string of bone rods in her hand.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait in the manner of an old silk painting, its colours yellowed and its edges darkened by age; a calm woman has stopped for one second to straighten a string of bone counting rods before handing over the last archive box, smoke thickening in the river air as she looks at the viewer, in the city's last hour. Face: a calm, plain, fine-boned face of about forty with olive skin, steady dark eyes, straight brows, a firm gentle mouth, a faint line between the brows and a fine line of soot across the brow. Hair: black, in a neat low coil held by a wooden pin. Body: slim and upright, elbows tucked in, neat even now. Clothing: modest, clean silk of a steward: an ochre robe of fine silk crossed at the collar, a rust outer vest edged in ochre with a thin gold line of geese along the border, wide sleeves tied with brown silk cord, a small jade bead at the belt. Hands and objects: a string of pale bone counting rods held up, each a short white stick; at her side a stack of wooden archive boxes. Power: a faint, soft earth-brown glow rests around her like lamplight, and a few pale golden motes rise from the closed boxes beside her. Background: a pale river quay with a moored boat being loaded by faint figures, a grey smear of smoke across the sky, thin mist on the water. Light: dim yellowish light as though through smoke, a soft pale rim on her shoulders, the picture softened to old-silk yellow at the edges. Expression: calm, honest and resolved, no fear, only a steady composure with a little rueful warmth at the corner of the mouth.

people.imagined: Dusk on a river landing. He has just sat down on the boards with a handful of boat nails and is grinding them with a stone, quietly, as he has every evening since he was seven. He is aware of Lô Xướng Vãn somewhere behind him and does not turn.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a river jetty at dusk, he looks up at the viewer with a quiet, level stare, a bandolier of black needles across his chest; he has just ground the twenty-fourth needle and set it in the bandolier with a small click. Face: a lean, calm, river-brown face of about twenty-five; narrow dark eyes without a flicker; straight even brows; a straight nose; a closed mouth with no smile; a small old scar on the chin and a thin white fishhook scar along the left jaw. Hair: black, tied in a plain low tail with a strip of black cord cut from an old net. Body: lean, narrow-shouldered, sitting cross-legged with his back straight, absolutely still. Clothing: the plain graceful silk of an inner disciple: a pale ochre inner robe, a rust jacket with tight sleeves, clean and simple with only a thin gold line of geese at the cuff; over the shoulders a tarred black-brown boatman's coat, old but oiled and carefully kept, the sleeves tar-stiff and a big wooden toggle at the neck. Hands and objects: a leather bandolier across the chest holds twenty-four black needles in two neat rows, each a thin dull-black spike, clearly visible; his right hand rests on a small whetstone beside him. Power: a faint blue-grey water shimmer clings to the needles, with cold small droplets of light drifting off their tips like mist. Background: a blurred grey river in silver evening mist, leaning wooden landing posts in the shallows, one lit stern lamp far off, one nail glinting on the planks. Light: dim red dusk glow on one side, a cool silver rim light along the needles and his jaw. Expression: calm, detached, patient, with a cold stillness; a coldness without cruelty, like deep water.

people.imagined: At the miasma's edge at night, one hand on the grey veil at her throat. She has just come back from walking three hundred paces into the dark, and she looks at her father's lantern with a stubborn eye.
people.subject: The moment: at night on the edge of a grey ash plain, she pulls a grey veil loose at her throat and looks at the viewer with a defiant, steady gaze, her hair cut very short; it is the third night since she came back from the three hundred paces and she has come to look at the grey again. Face: a long, strong, weathered face of about thirty-five with high cheekbones; grey-tinged tan skin; clear dark eyes; thick straight brows; a firm mouth; shiny pink burn marks along the scalp line and one ear, the left ear notched. Hair: cropped very short and uneven like a boy's, dark with a patch of scorched ash-grey above the left ear; no ornament. Body: tall, rangy, long-armed, rawboned, shoulders squared and feet planted a little too wide. Clothing: a true disciple's silk worn for the work: a rust robe with a dusk-violet jacket of fine silk bordered in gold with flying geese, the cuffs bound with grey cord; a grey gauze veil soaked in tincture and stained brown at its edges, loose around the neck and hanging over the collarbone, clearly visible. Hands and objects: the left hand tugs the veil; the right holds a short plain flying sword in a dark grey scabbard point-down. Power: a faint earth-brown and pale blue aura flickers around her, pushing thin grey wisps of miasma back from her shoulders, and a few small motes of pale light dance at the sword's scabbard. Background: black night, a wall of grey miasma mist, the Watch's green lantern burning far behind her like a small drowned star. Light: faint green lantern light from the left and below, cold silver moonlight as rim light on her cropped head. Expression: a set jaw and a restless, proud stare fixed on something over the viewer's shoulder.

people.imagined: At the outer gate, in the old seat's schoolroom, chalk on his sleeves, signing a placement he has no say in. He smiles mildly while thinking of his son's name on a list.
people.subject: The moment: at the slate board of an old schoolroom, he turns from the chalk with a mild, tired smile, a writing brush in his hand, having set down the pen to wipe chalk from his hands with the Placement Day list half signed and his son's name somewhere on it. Face: a soft, round, mild face of about forty-five with fair skin, small gentle brown eyes, thin low brows, a short nose, a small warm mouth, a double chin, slightly sticking-out ears and soft cheeks with a faint blush. Hair: thin black going grey, in a small topknot with a wooden pin. Body: short, plump and slightly stooped, a small pot belly against the board. Clothing: the plain graceful silk of a gate steward: a clean pale ochre robe of soft silk crossed at the collar with a thin gold line of sunset clouds, a brown silk sash, wide sleeves dusted white with chalk to the elbow; a small grey goose-feather pin at the collar. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a short stick of white chalk, fingertips white; the left holds a writing brush above a blank paper form. Power: none, only a faint warm brown shimmer like sunlit dust where the chalk hangs in the air. Background: a black slate board covered with faint chalk circles and a half-erased column of sums, a sunlit window with thin mist, drifting chalk dust glowing. Light: soft warm afternoon sunlight through the window, a gentle golden rim light on his round cheek and shoulder. Expression: a kind, tired, humble smile with worried eyes above it, a mild man trying to look calm while thinking about one name on one list.

people.imagined: Between two stalls in a market, he lets his smile arrive a beat too early. One of his three pouches is fat, one thin, one flat and empty, and he touches the empty one.
people.subject: The moment: at a busy market, he gives a quick, bright merchant's smile at the viewer while one hand touches a flat empty pouch at his belt, a bargain just closed and his eyes already seeking the next buyer. Face: a round, well-fed, rosy face of about forty-two with a quick wide smile, bright dark eyes with laugh lines, thick brows, a small wispy moustache, a plump chin, smooth-shaven cheeks and gold studs in his ears. Hair: black, in a glossy topknot with a gilt pin. Body: stout, broad and well fed, a thick waist and large gestures. Clothing: a true disciple's rich silk, a little too bright: a pale ochre under-robe, a rust robe of excellent silk, a dusk-violet outer jacket with wide sleeves embroidered at the borders with gold geese and sunset clouds, a wide dusk-violet brocade sash; on the belt three cloth money pouches in red, green and grey, one full and round, one half full and one flat and empty, plainly visible. Hands and objects: the right hand rests on the flat pouch; the left holds a small bundle of coloured sample silk. Power: a glimmer of warm gold and earth-brown qi sparkles around him like coins catching light, with a few luminous gold motes drifting from his sleeves. Background: blurred market stalls with awnings of red and ochre silk, hanging cloth in bright colours, a crowd of blurred hats, paper lanterns with golden glow. Light: bright warm market sunlight with a gold gleam on the gilt pin and a soft golden rim light. Expression: quick, hungry and genial, the smile easy and the eyes calculating, a merchant whose goodwill is real and whose arithmetic is faster.

people.imagined: Deep in the galleries under the seat, a lamp on her forehead, dust in every crease. She has just passed the locked door again and does not look back at it.
people.subject: The moment: in a dark stone gallery she looks at the viewer with her head-lamp lit, having just stopped at a locked door and decided not to ask, and not looking back at it. Face: a small, plain, round face of about forty-five with a snub nose wide at the nostril, dust-grey cheeks, small steady dark eyes, thick dust-grey brows, a small thin mouth and dust caught in every crease of the eyes and mouth. Hair: black, tied back under a broad strap across the forehead holding a small tin lamp with a steady yellow flame, clearly visible. Body: small, stout and sturdy, feet turned out like a miner's. Clothing: the graceful but practical silk of an inner disciple: a rust robe over an ochre inner robe, clean at the front but powdered with grey dust in every fold like flour, a dusk-violet brocade sash, wide sleeves tied back with silk cord, the cuffs bordered in gold with geese. Hands and objects: one hand holds a short pale knotted silver-pine pole with a small grey cloth flag; the other presses against a rough stone wall. Power: faint silver-grey threads of formation light run from her palm into the stone, and tiny silver motes float like dust in her lamplight. Background: a dark cut-stone gallery with timber props, a heavy iron-bound door at the edge of the lamp's reach with a fresh scuff of dust on its sill, pale silver mist at the floor. Light: warm yellow head-lamp light from the front with deep shadow around, a faint silver shimmer from the stone as a rim light. Expression: reserved and wary, the lips pressed and the dark eyes guarded, an honest woman keeping a question to herself.

people.imagined: On a bay-festival stage at dusk, a zither half out of its bag. She has just sung a line and her mother's face in a far window comes into her mind; she holds the smile.
people.subject: The moment: on a festival stage, she lifts her chin in song and glances at the viewer with a warm smile that stops short of her eyes; a line of the Evening Song has just ended and the last note hangs, and her gaze goes to a far window where she cannot see her mother. Face: a slender, pretty, oval face of about thirty-eight; fair skin; large liquid dark eyes with shadow beneath; delicate arched brows; a small red mouth; a faint worry line; a tiny beauty mark under the left eye. Hair: black, long, half up with two silver combs, the rest down her back. Body: slender, graceful, long neck, shoulders open. Clothing: graceful festival silks of an inner disciple: a dusk-violet robe shading to the red of sunset at the hem with long wide sleeves tied up with silk cords, a pale ochre sash, a drifting sunset-gold gauze shawl embroidered at its borders with geese and sunset clouds in gold; a pressed red leaf pinned at the collar. Hands and objects: a long zither in a faded grey bag, slung from her shoulder, half out of its bag, the strings and one wooden end showing clearly. Power: a faint warm gold and green shimmer follows the sound of her song, like fine light threads rippling off the zither strings, and a few luminous motes float up toward the lanterns. Background: blurred round red paper lanterns hanging in rows along the stage, the dark water of the bay shining behind, a soft crowd, thin mist. Light: warm red lantern light with a golden glow along her cheek, a soft pearly rim light on the silk. Expression: warm, falsely bright, anxious; the eyes are bright with a thin film of wet.

people.imagined: At her high desk in the Counting House, abacus clicking in her sleeve, in the middle of saying something that contradicts her superior. She has found a number that won't add up.
people.subject: The moment: mid-sentence at a high desk, she raises one eyebrow at the viewer and her sleeve clicks; a figure has not tallied and she cannot let it go. Face: a brisk, sharp, thin face of about thirty-eight; warm brown skin; quick bright eyes; straight arched brows with one lifted; a pointed chin; a mouth slightly pursed to speak; ink on the cheek; sharp cheekbones and a faint line between the brows. Hair: black, in a tight bun pierced with a brass pin. Body: slim, quick, upright, rising slightly on her toes at the high desk. Clothing: neat clerk's silk: an excellent rust robe crossed at an ochre collar with a thin gold border of geese, the wide sleeves tied back with silk cord and stitched inside in brown, a small jade bead at the belt; from the right sleeve the round wooden edge of a small abacus peeks. Hands and objects: the right hand lifts a brush; the left hand's quick ink-stained fingers rest on the small brown-bead abacus half out of her sleeve, clearly visible. Power: a faint earth-brown shimmer dances around her fingers, a few tiny golden motes flicking off the abacus beads each time they click. Background: tall wooden shelves of lidded boxes receding behind her, each with a tag of red thread, a paper lantern glowing amber, thin mist at the ceiling. Light: warm lantern glow from the side, a soft pearly rim light on her sleeve and cheek. Expression: brisk, stubborn, impatient; she looks ready to argue and sure that she is right.

people.imagined: In the maple terraces, talking with both hands and his whole face about the move, green on his nails, completely sure.
people.subject: The moment: in the middle of an eager speech on the maple terraces, he gestures with both hands and leans toward the viewer; he is telling the same story about the move for the hundredth time and has come to the best part. Face: a long, expressive, gangly face of about forty; light skin with an excited flush; wide bright eyes; high lifted brows; a big grin; a prominent Adam's apple; a long chin and big ears that stick out a little. Hair: light brown, tied in a messy knot with a leaf stuck in it. Body: gangly, tall, long arms in motion, all elbows and knees, bending at the waist when he speaks. Clothing: graceful inner-disciple silk worn carelessly: a rust robe with very wide loose sleeves that flap when he gestures, a dusk-violet collar embroidered in gold with maple leaves and geese, a plain green silk cord for a belt; a pressed red maple leaf pinned at the collar. Hands and objects: both hands up and spread, the fingernails stained bright green, clearly visible; one hand holds a few green herb leaves. Power: bright green-gold wood qi sparkles on his green fingertips and the herb leaves, tiny glowing green motes drifting up like pollen in the air around his sleeves. Background: terraces of herbs climbing in green steps behind him, one maple scarlet at the top, falling red and green leaves in soft golden mist. Light: bright golden sunlight with a golden rim light on his hair and sleeves. Expression: eager, arrogant, animated; he is delighted with himself and does not notice it.

people.imagined: Standing on a shingle shore. She has stopped walking and turned to face the sea, as she does whenever she stops. She is thinking of a fleet.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a shingle shore with her face turned toward the sea, she glances over her shoulder at the viewer; the tide pulls at the shingle and she turns her back to the land again, thinking of a fleet. Face: a weathered, strong face of about forty; sun-darkened skin with deep squint lines; steady grey-green eyes; straight dark brows; a firm mouth with lips cracked by salt; salt on her cheek. Hair: dark brown with grey, in a thick braid wound around her head, wind-loosened, a silver comb at the crown. Body: athletic, broad-shouldered, legs apart, hands behind her back. Clothing: graceful silk of an inner disciple, salt-faded: a rust robe with wide sleeves tied back, a dusk-violet jacket bordered in gold with geese, a long sea-grey cloak of gauze over one shoulder, its edge stiff with dried salt, drifting in the wind. Hands and objects: one hand holds a rolled grey cloth tied with a cord of blue thread; the other rests on her belt. Power: a faint blue-grey water shimmer curls at the hem of her cloak like sea mist, and a few pale pearl motes lift from the wet shingle around her feet. Background: a grey sea and pale horizon under low drifting spirit-mist, wet shingle, one white sail a mere speck at the horizon. Light: cold bright sea light from one side, a pearly silver rim light along her braid and cloak. Expression: restless, brave, looking away; she looks restless as if the shore is a place she is only passing through.
